executiveSummary: Sep 8 starts from a likely digestion/rotation setup after Sep 7's narrow Nikkei +2.12% rally. U.S. cash market is closed for Labor Day, so there is no fresh U.S. cash-session confirmation overnight. Domestic macro releases at 08:30/08:50, after-hours disclosures, PTS, yen strength, oil and SQ-week derivatives matter more than usual. The strongest fresh after-close stock-specific items are Hagihara Industries earnings/DBJ tie-up, Quantum Solutions AI data-center server acquisition, Resonac partial spin-off listing approval, and Dynamic Map Platform margin-trading restrictions as a negative event. Semiconductors remain the main structural theme, but Sep 7 PTS shows some cooling in Kioxia and SBG after sharp cash-session gains.
